drafted_from: workflow row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (input_schema and the case, evidence, opportunity steps with their submit shapes); read from the row's words, no test runs it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:real-life-cases to find real situations where small bakery owners struggle to train new staff, from forums and video comments, with no private data and sources kept."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Write the request, its scope, the constraints (source terms, privacy) and the actions you authorize; add source_id when it came from a shared source.
2. Say "Run workflow:real-life-cases". The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps case, evidence, opportunity.

3. At case, real situations are found from current authorized sources; when they are comments under other people's posts, the AI runs workflow:answer-commenters-with-videos for its watch, keep and pick steps.
4. At evidence, each case keeps its author, link, date and excerpt, with supporting and contradicting evidence; at opportunity, read which cases are worth acting on and why.

worked_examples.title: Finding the cases
worked_examples.ask: Find real cases of bakery owners struggling to train staff.

input.request: Find real situations where small bakery owners struggle to train new staff.
input.scope: Public forums and video comments only
authorized_actions: Write case rows to my account

worked_examples.given: Read from tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (step case): the answer holds a summary, evidence (id, source, observed) and requirements find-cases and capability-review-case, each completed with what happened and evidence_refs.
